import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/customer_segments.csv')

# Create derived features
df['Age'] = 2024 - df['Year_Birth']
df['Total_Spending'] = (df['MntWines'] + df['MntFruits'] + df['MntMeatProducts'] + 
                        df['MntFishProducts'] + df['MntSweetProducts'] + df['MntGoldProds'])
df['Total_Children'] = df['Kidhome'] + df['Teenhome']
df['Total_Purchases'] = (df['NumWebPurchases'] + df['NumCatalogPurchases'] + 
                         df['NumStorePurchases'] + df['NumDealsPurchases'])

# Remove outliers for better visualization
df_clean = df[(df['Income'] < df['Income'].quantile(0.99)) & 
              (df['Age'] < 100) & 
              (df['Total_Spending'] < df['Total_Spending'].quantile(0.99))]

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# 1. Income vs Total Spending by Children
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
for children in sorted(df_clean['Total_Children'].unique()):
    mask = df_clean['Total_Children'] == children
    ax1.scatter(df_clean[mask]['Income'], df_clean[mask]['Total_Spending'], 
               alpha=0.5, s=30, label=f'{int(children)} children')
ax1.set_xlabel('Annual Income', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Total Spending', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Income vs Total Spending by Number of Children', fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(title='Children at Home', loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
ax2.hist(df_clean['Age'], bins=30, color='steelblue', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 3. Spending by Category
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
spending_categories = ['MntWines', 'MntFruits', 'MntMeatProducts', 
                       'MntFishProducts', 'MntSweetProducts', 'MntGoldProds']
category_means = [df_clean[cat].sum() for cat in spending_categories]
category_labels = ['Wines', 'Fruits', 'Meat', 'Fish', 'Sweets', 'Gold']
colors = plt.cm.Set3(np.linspace(0, 1, len(category_labels)))
ax3.pie(category_means, labels=category_labels, autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors)
ax3.set_title('Spending Distribution by Category', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Education Level Distribution
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
education_counts = df_clean['Education'].value_counts()
ax4.barh(education_counts.index, education_counts.values, color='coral', edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Education Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Customer Education Levels', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 5. Purchase Channel Preferences
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
purchase_channels = ['NumWebPurchases', 'NumCatalogPurchases', 
                     'NumStorePurchases', 'NumDealsPurchases']
channel_totals = [df_clean[ch].sum() for ch in purchase_channels]
channel_labels = ['Web', 'Catalog', 'Store', 'Deals']
bars = ax5.bar(channel_labels, channel_totals, color=['#1f77b4', '#ff7f0e', '#2ca02c', '#d62728'], 
               edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Purchases', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Purchase Channel Preferences', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 6. Income by Education
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :2])
education_order = df_clean.groupby('Education')['Income'].median().sort_values().index
sns.boxplot(data=df_clean, x='Education', y='Income', order=education_order, 
            palette='Set2', ax=ax6)
ax6.set_xlabel('Education Level', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Annual Income', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Income Distribution by Education Level', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')

# 7. Campaign Acceptance Rate
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
campaigns = ['AcceptedCmp1', 'AcceptedCmp2', 'AcceptedCmp3', 'AcceptedCmp4', 'AcceptedCmp5', 'Response']
acceptance_rates = [df_clean[cmp].sum() / len(df_clean) * 100 for cmp in campaigns]
campaign_labels = ['Cmp1', 'Cmp2', 'Cmp3', 'Cmp4', 'Cmp5', 'Last Cmp']
bars = ax7.bar(campaign_labels, acceptance_rates, color='mediumpurple', edgecolor='black')
ax7.set_ylabel('Acceptance Rate (%)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Campaign Acceptance Rates', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(alpha=0.3, axis='y')
ax7.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

plt.suptitle('Customer Segmentation Analysis Dashboard', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
